findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings, compare_asking_prices · Private data: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_listing, get_contact_options, data_layer_stats · Destructive: search_properties, corpus_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings, compare_asking_prices · Private data: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_listing, get_contact_options, data_layer_stats · Destructive: search_properties, corpus_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
